title: Graphic Designer
description:
Graphic Designer


Our Client is hiring a designer to support a high-output marketing team. This is not a brand-from-scratch role. The design system exists, and the job is to execute consistently, extend it intelligently, and keep things moving without hand-holding.


You’ll work directly with Marketing, with guidance from the Creative Director. Most of what you produce will show up in demand gen campaigns, event programs, and product marketing. It needs to look sharp, ship fast, and hold up across channels.


What you’ll do

  • You’ll be responsible for a wide range of design work tied directly to pipeline-driving campaigns
  • Create graphics for social, paid campaigns, email, and web
  • Design and iterate on landing pages in Webflow
  • Produce visual assets for webinars, virtual events, and campaigns
  • Design print collateral and occasional physical assets (including SWAG)
  • Create GIFs, motion elements, and lightweight animations
  • Edit video for social distribution and website use
  • Support ongoing campaign launches with fast-turn creative
  • This is a volume role, and you’ll be expected to make good decisions quickly and maintain quality under pace.


What matters in this role

  • You can operate inside an existing brand system without needing constant direction
  • You understand how design actually shows up in B2B marketing, not just how it looks in a portfolio
  • You’re comfortable moving between formats. Static, motion, web, video. No one is handing off perfect briefs every time
  • You have strong judgment about what’s “good enough to ship” vs what needs refinement
  • You can manage your own workflow and keep projects moving without bottlenecks


Requirements

  • 4+ years in a design role, ideally supporting marketing or growth teams
  • Strong portfolio that shows real campaign work, not just one-off visuals
  • Experience designing in Webflow (not just Figma concepts)
  • Experience with motion design and basic animation (GIFs, short-form video)
  • Video editing experience for social and web content
  • Fluency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite


Context for the work

Our client sells to B2B marketing teams running webinars and virtual events as part of pipeline generation. That means the creative you produce will be tied directly to:

  • Driving registrations and product demos
  • Increasing engagement
  • Supporting sales follow-up
  • Reinforcing brand credibility with senior marketing leaders

The output needs to feel polished, but it has to perform, not just look good.


What this is not

  • Not a pure brand exploration role
  • Not a pixel-perfect, weeks-per-project environment
  • Not isolated design work handed over a wall


You’ll be in the middle of campaigns, working closely with marketers who are moving fast and expect the same from you.


If that sounds like your kind of environment, this will be a good fit.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Senior Backend Engineer (PHP/Laravel)


Location: Brazil



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Senior Backend Engineer (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


Position Overview:


As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will play a key role in the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions to support the company's mission and goals. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.


Primary Responsibilities:


  • Platform Development: Spearhead the development and optimization of our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel, ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Database Development: Creating database schemas that represent and support business processes
  • API Development and Integration: Develop and maintain APIs for internal and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare systems and third-party services.
  • Security Compliance: Ensure the platform's compliance with healthcare industry standards, including HIPAA, by implementing and maintaining robust security measures and data protection protocols.


Additional Responsibilities:


  • Mentor junior developers, providing guidance on best practices in backend development, code review, and team collaboration.
  • Stay abreast of new technology trends and evaluate their application to continually innovate and enhance the platform.
  • Participate in an agile development environment, contributing to planning, daily stand-ups, and continuous collaboration to ensure timely delivery of high-quality software.



Competencies/Requirements:


  • Technical Expertise: Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and MySQL. Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git.
  • Experience: At least 5 years of experience in backend development, with a proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web applications. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is highly desirable.
  • Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to tackle complex problems, think analytically, and develop innovative solutions.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Attention to Detail: A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and efficient platform.


Benefits:

title: Sap Consultant
description:
About the Role


The SAP MDG (Material Master Data) Consultant is responsible for designing, configuring, enhancing, and supporting SAP MDG function for all types of master data, and its integration with S/4HANA and other applications across global enterprises. The role ensures data governance, master data quality, workflow enforcement and compliance with business rules. This key role focuses on providing technology solutions for business requirements, providing global design and localization as warranted, stabilizing and enhancing the existing solutions, resolving defects, production break-fixes, as well as providing recommendation regarding optimal business processes by leveraging SAP best practices. This person will collaborate with the Product Owner, Project managers, system architects and the business partners to understand key objectives and challenges, ensure successful outcomes, and provide the right direction in the dynamic business environment.



Responsibilities



  • Serve as the subject matter expert for solution development in the SAP MDG area
  • Design, configure, and implement SAP MDG solutions for domains such as Business Partner, Customer, Vendor, Material, and Finance.
  • Lead end-to-end MDG implementations, including requirements gathering, blueprinting, configuration, testing, and go-live support
  • Configure MDG data models, change request types, workflows, business rules, validations, and derivations
  • Integrate SAP MDG with ECC, S/4HANA, and non-SAP systems
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to define data governance processes, roles, and policies
  • Support data migration, data cleansing, and data quality initiatives
  • Configure and support BRF+, Workflow (WS-BPEL/Flexible Workflow), DRF, and UI (Fiori/Web Dynpro)
  • Perform configuration of systems and manage transport as part of ITSM, Cloud ALM, and change management across the SAP landscape
  • Provide production support, issue resolution, and continuous improvement enhancements
  • Create functional and technical documentation, including design specs, test scripts, and user guides
  • Support user training and knowledge transfer activities to the managed service team.
  • Ensure compliance with data standards, audit requirements, and best practices
  • Perform Functional Unit testing, Product testing, System integration testing, cross functional testing, testing of SAP upgrades, Performance testing, etc.
  • Support UAT, provide user training and support change management and business enablement.
  • Manage and maintain overall solution architecture, scalability, and integrity.
  • Provides hands-on support to developers (e.G., resolving technical blockers and reviewing code)
  • Other job duties and projects as assigned.


Qualifications



  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 5+ years of experience in SAP Master Data Governance


Required Skills



  • Strong hands-on experience with SAP MDG-BP, MDG-M, MDG-F, or MDG-S.
  • Experience with SAP S/4HANA integration and other SAAS and non-SAP systems.
  • Solid understanding of data governance frameworks and master data lifecycle
  • Experience configuring: Data Models & Change Request Types, BRF+ Rules, Workflow, Data Replication Framework (DRF)
  • Knowledge of Fiori apps and MDG UI customization
  • Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including data analysts, IT, and business stakeholders, to ensure seamless integration and alignment of MDG solutions.
  • Training and Support: Provide training and support to team members and end-users on MDG best practices and solutions.
  • Provide regular reports on system health and performance.
  • Knowledge of agile methodologies and frameworks such as Kanban as well as use of tools like Jira and Service Now.
  • Facilitate work and resource estimation, track progress, provide escalations and status updates.


Preferred Skills



  • SAP MDG Certification

Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo:

A missão do Consultor em Mercado Imobiliário é maximizar a eficiência e o valor do portfólio imobiliário da empresa, atuando como o especialista principal na negociação e gestão dos contratos de aluguel classificados de alto valor. Sua responsabilidade é garantir que esses contratos estratégicos ofereçam as melhores condições financeiras e operacionais, mitigando riscos e gerando economia significativa para a organização.


Sobre a área:

Responsável em gerir os contratos de aluguel das unidades de negocio de toda organização, garantindo que as cláusulas contratuais sejam cumpridas na íntegra entre locador e locatário, sempre com total aderência a legislação vigente que rege as locações imobiliárias. O setor comanda as negociações de aluguel, buscando constantemente as melhores condições de preço, prazo e reajustes em conformidade com os indexadores imobiliários.


Principais atividades:

  • Negociação Estratégica: conduzir todas as negociações de aluguel e renovação para os contratos de alto valor, com foco em obter reduções de custo, prazos favoráveis e cláusulas contratuais vantajosas.
  • Análise de Viabilidade: realizar análises de custo-benefício e de mercado detalhadas para cada imóvel estratégico, apresentando recomendações claras para a alta gestão.
  • Relacionamento com Locadores: Gerenciar o relacionamento com proprietários, administradoras e corretores de alto nível, mantendo uma comunicação eficaz para resolver questões complexas.
  • Gestão de Riscos: identificar e mitigar riscos legais e financeiros associados aos contratos de alto valor, atuando em colaboração com o departamento jurídico.
  • Elaboração de Relatórios: criar relatórios de desempenho e de economia detalhados, comunicando os resultados de suas negociações de forma clara para a gerência e diretoria.
  • Gerir toda a carteira de propriedades de alto valor alugadas pela empresa, garantindo que cada contrato esteja alinhado com as necessidades operacionais e financeiras.



Buscamos alguém que apresente:

  • Graduação em Direito, Administração de Empresas, Economia ou Engenharia.
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão Imobiliária, Finanças Corporativas ou Negociação é um diferencial competitivo.
  • Experiência sólida em negociação e gestão de contratos imobiliários, preferencialmente com foco em imóveis de alto valor.
  • Conhecimento do mercado imobiliário e seus indexadores (IGP-M, IPCA etc.), além de experiência em avaliações de propriedades comerciais.

title: Sap S/4hana Finance Consultant
description:
Genesis Consulting has an immediate opportunity for an experienced SAP S/4HANA Finance (FI) Consultant to support a global operation S/4HANA. The consultant will play a critical role in the implementation, configuration, and optimization of core financial processes within SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition. Our clients are some of the world’s leading companies and the candidate will be a part of challenging projects to build and support technical solutions for their needs.



The SAP S/4HANA FI Consultant will act as a functional utility player across the Finance workstream, supporting General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Funds Management, and integration with Procurement, Asset Management, and Payroll. The role requires hands-on participation across all phases of the implementation lifecycle, including design, configuration, testing, cutover, and post-go-live support.



The consultant will work closely with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams to ensure financial processes are aligned to SAP S/4HANA best practices while supporting the client’s operational and regulatory requirements. This includes supporting the transition from ECC-based processes to S/4HANA capabilities, including Fiori-enabled user experiences and embedded analytics.



The FI Consultant will also assist in identifying opportunities to streamline legacy processes, reduce customizations, and leverage standard S/4HANA functionality, while ensuring continuity of critical financial operations during the system conversion.



Duties and Responsibilities:


The Consultant facilitates the implementation and support of SAP S/4HANA Finance solutions to enhance the client’s financial operations and overall system performance, while maintaining a high degree of customer satisfaction.


  • Configure and support SAP S/4HANA Finance components including GL, AP, AR, Asset Accounting
  • Participate in fit-to-standard workshops and support design decisions aligned to S/4HANA best practices
  • Act as a cross-functional contributor, supporting integration points between Finance and modules such as MM (Procurement), EAM (Asset Management), HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems
  • Support the migration and validation of financial data, including balances, open items, and asset data during conversion activities
  • Assist in identifying and supporting remediation of custom code, reports, interfaces, and enhancements impacting Finance processes
  • Support Fiori application enablement, including validation of finance-related apps, roles, and user experience considerations
  • Participate in System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and defect resolution across financial and cross-functional scenarios
  • Collaborate with technical and data teams to support integration, reporting, and data reconciliation activities
  • Support cutover planning and execution, including financial readiness activities and validation of key processes
  • Provide post-go-live support and stabilization assistance for financial operations



Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

  • 3-5 years of SAP experience with a strong focus on Finance (FI) in ECC and S/4HANA environments
  • At least two full lifecycle SAP implementations, including at least one S/4HANA conversion or implementation
  • Hands-on experience with core FI modules including GL, AP, AR, and Asset Accounting
  • Functional integration experience with SAP modules including MM, EAM, HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems
  • Experience supporting financial data migration, reconciliation, and validation activities
  • Experience with SAP Fiori applications and understanding of role-based access and user experience
  • Experience supporting testing cycles including SIT and UAT in integrated SAP environments
  • Working knowledge of custom code impacts (reports, interfaces, enhancements) and ability to support functional validation
  • Experience with SAP reporting and analytics, including embedded analytics or BW-based reporting
  • Strong understanding of financial close processes, including month-end and year-end activities
  • Experience working in Agile or SAP Activate-based delivery models


Minimum Education:


  • Bachelor’s Degree – Preferred
  • Bachelor of Science or Computer Science, Information Systems, Electrical/Computer Engineering or equivalent experience preferred or Accounting (preferred).



Required Certifications:


  • Certification in S/4 HANA, and/or other SAP Solutions is a plus.



Other:


  • Experience working in distributed delivery environments, including coordination with offshore or nearshore teams (e.G., LATAM delivery centers)
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work directly with business stakeholders
  • Ability to support a hybrid delivery model with remote and on-site collaboration as required

title: Lead Full-Stack Developer (.Net+Angular)
description:
LUXOFT ONLY OPERATES UNDER CLT CONTRACT

PLEASE APPLY WITH YOUR ENGLISH CV


The Mission

We are building the next generation of real-time solutions for our Risk Management and Portfolio Management teams. This isn’t just maintenance;
you will be part of a small, elite agile squad of technologists tasked with re-engineering how we handle high-throughput, latency-sensitive financial data.

We value the "Full Lifecycle Engineer"—someone who takes pride in owning a feature from the initial whiteboard sketch and requirements gathering through to implementation, automated testing, and production monitoring.


Technical DNA

We are looking for a specialist in the .NET ecosystem who treats performance as a feature, not an afterthought. You should possess:

  • Architectural Mastery: A deep obsession with Clean Architecture , SOLID principles, and design patterns. You believe code should be as readable as it is fast.
  • Performance Engineering: Real-world experience building Low-Latency/High-Throughput systems. You know how to find bottlenecks using profiling tools and how to mitigate them.
  • The Concurrent Mindset: Expertise in TPL (Async/Await) and a deep understanding of thread safety and synchronization. You don't just use lock;
    you understand why you're using it.
  • Data at Scale: Mastery of SQL Server performance tuning, from execution plans to index optimization, ensuring our data layer scales with our ambitions.

The Toolkit (Must-Haves)

  • Core: C# / .NET 8 (or ASP.NET Core)
  • Patterns: Clean Architecture, DI/IoC (Autofac/Microsoft), Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
  • Data: SQL Server, T-SQL, Stored Procedures, and Query Tuning.
  • Infrastructure: Distributed Systems, Microservices, and Cloud-native design.
  • Reliability: Monitoring & Observability (App Insights/Prometheus), Memory Management (GC Tuning).
  • Operations: Full SDLC ownership, including CI/CD and Production Support.

What Makes You Stand Out

  • You have an independent mindset but crave a collaborative environment.
  • You have a "Builder" mentality—you enjoy solving the complex math and logic behind Risk Management.
  • You don't just fix bugs;
    you identify systemic risks and propose architectural improvements.

- Build trust through genuine conversation - not scripts or pressure tactics

- Entrepreneurs, business owners, and investors with €250,000–€800,000+ to invest

- Self-made successes who built wealth through talent and persistence

- Often from environments where institutions have failed them - they’re sceptical for good reason

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (Typescript + React)
description:
Role Overview: Own full-stack product end-to-end. Lead Product engineering role with strong ownership, full direct communication with the client and AI workflows.

Experience Level: 7+ years

Location: Remote

Tech Stack: TypeScript + React, Prisma, Fastify, Mantine

Contract Type: Full-time, B2B contract


About the Role

Radity is a global software engineering company delivering innovative digital solutions to clients around the world. We are passionate about building great technology and fostering a collaborative environment where people grow, take ownership, and make a real impact.


Our client is a US insurance company, subsidiary of Fortune 500 companies. This is an “insurance startup” with an agile culture and approach to work, and future oriented approach to technology. Product is internally developed Claims Management system. The product is in the early development stage. Once MVP goes live, project will continue to stabilize the product and enhance it with new features and AI -powered workflows embedded directly into real business processes.


Radity is running software development projects with the client for more than 3 years. This is not an outsourcing role, but a real product engineering role, where you will be part of a big joint Radity and Client team. Engineers are trusted with context, real problems, and responsibility for delivering outcomes.


You’ll work closely with product managers, designers, and sometimes clients to design, build, and evolve a complex platform used by insurance professionals every day.


What You’ll Do

  • Own features end to end — from understanding the business problem to solution design, implementation, deployment, and iteration
  • Design and build backend services using TypeScript, Prisma and Fastify
  • Develop modern frontend features using React and TypeScript
  • Work with PostgreSQL
  • Contribute to the evolution of the platform architecture and technical standards
  • Build and integrate AI-powered workflows that support complex claims management business flows, using existing AI services and tooling where appropriate
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and stakeholders to shape solutions, not just implement requirements
  • Take responsibility for testing, CI/CD, releases, and production readiness
  • Continuously improve performance, reliability, observability, and developer experience
  • Use modern AI-assisted coding tools as part of daily engineering work


What We’re Looking For

  • 7+ years of professional experience as a software engineer
  • Strong hands-on experience with TypeScript + React, Prisma
  • Experience building and operating real production systems (not just isolated components)
  • Solid understanding of system design, architecture, and trade-offs
  • Comfort working with incomplete requirements and asking the right questions
  • Experience with Azure or similar cloud platforms
  • Practical experience with CI/CD, automated testing, and deployments
  • Product-oriented mindset — focus on user value and business outcomes
  • Active, practical use of AI tools in daily development
  • Experience in client-facing or stakeholder discussions
  • Upper-Intermediate English or higher


Nice to have (not required)

  • Insurtech background


Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive market-level compensation based on experience and location
  • Generous vacation policy
  • Full equipment provided
  • Paid access to modern AI tools, learning resources, and subscriptions
  • Support for continuous learning and professional development
  • Strong engineering culture with high trust and autonomy


Why This Role

  • High ownership and real influence on product direction
  • Engineers are trusted to think, design, and decide, not just execute
  • Direct Exposure to the top engineering team
  • AI is a real working tool and part of the product, not a buzzword
  • Long-term product vision with solid business fundamentals


Recruitment process

  • Recruiter Screen: short intro call to align on experience, mindset, location, and compensation
  • Hiring Manager Interview: product- and case-focused discussion with an Engineering Manager (no take-home task)
  • Interview with the Client’s CTO
  • Offer

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.


A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS);
painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR);

description:
Sensor Tower is seeking an Innovation & Strategy Engineer to join our I&S team as it continues to grow and deliver cutting-edge market intelligence solutions to our most valued clients. Reporting directly to the Director of Innovation and Strategy, this role offers a unique opportunity for someone with hands-on experience in data analytics and consulting. You will collaborate directly with customers and engineers to develop and implement innovative market data solutions, contributing to Sensor Tower's leadership in the industry.


Please note: This is an individual contributor role with no management responsibilities.

Employment: Full-time under a B2B contract.


What the Innovation & Strategy will do:


  • Entrepreneurial Innovation & Data Utilization: Leverage your hands-on experience with data to explore and define innovative solutions, developing new use-cases for data assets that scale to create strategic opportunities
  • Data-Driven Storytelling: Employ strong analytical and storytelling skills to transform complex data into compelling narratives that communicate insights and persuade stakeholders both internally and externally.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with sales, engineering, and customers to develop and implement comprehensive solutions, ensuring strategic alignment and integration
  • Client Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, including Fortune 500 companies, ensuring their success through strategic insights and tailored solutions.
  • Sales & Strategic Support: Partner with the Sales Team to support business development efforts, articulating the strategic impact of our solutions and aiding in the proposal process.


Experience and skills that the candidate can bring:


  • Data Proficiency: Proven ability to manage and analyze large datasets independently, developing innovative solutions and actionable insights. Expertise in data analysis and visualization tools (SQL, Python, Excel, Tableau, Power BI).
  • Strategic Thinking: Demonstrated track record of identifying, scaling, and creating new data use-cases that drive significant business value. An entrepreneurial approach to developing strategic opportunities.
  • Communication and Collaboration: Ability to transform complex data into compelling narratives for diverse stakeholders.
  • Experience in cross-functional collaboration with sales, engineering, and client teams to implement integrated solutions.
  • Client Relations: Proven experience in building and maintaining strategic relationships with high-profile clients, including Fortune 500 companies, focusing on client success and satisfaction.


Fraud warning: It's common for scammers to create positions that look legitimate on other sites. To ensure your submission is considered, only apply for positions at Sensor Tower through our company website or through posts directly associated with Sensor Tower company profiles on sites such as, Indeed, BuiltIn or Hackajob.


At no point will Sensor Tower ever ask for money, credit card, or bank account information to complete a job application. Communications received from Sensor Tower are only sent by e-mail addresses ending in sensortower.Com. All Sensor Tower interviews will be conducted via phone or Zoom. At no time will a conversation be moved to an alternative email outside of sensortower.Com or text.

title: Coordenador De Compras
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Coordenador(a) de Compras para liderar nossa área de suprimentos, garantindo o abastecimento eficiente de matérias-primas, ingredientes, embalagens e demais materiais essenciais para a produção de alimentos, nacionais e importados.


É mandatório possuir inglês fluente!

Se você tem perfil analítico, dinâmico, forte habilidade em negociação e experiência na gestão de equipes e fornecedores, essa oportunidade é para você!


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Coordenar o processo de compras de materiais produtivos e não produtivos, garantindo abastecimento contínuo.
  • Negociar com fornecedores buscando melhores condições de preço, prazo e qualidade.
  • Gerenciar níveis de estoque e alinhar compras ao junto á area de PCP.
  • Desenvolver e homologar fornecedores, assegurando performance e conformidade.
  • Liderar e desenvolver a equipe de compras, promovendo eficiência e resultados.
  • Acompanhar indicadores da área (custos, prazos, qualidade e estoque) e propor melhorias.
  • Realizar análise de mercado e identificar oportunidades de otimização e redução de custos.
  • Controlar o orçamento da área, assegurando eficiência financeira.
  • Coordenar processos de importação, incluindo negociação internacional, logística e compliance.


Requisitos necessários

  • Inglês fluente (mandatório)
  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Comércio Exterior ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida em compras, preferencialmente na indústria de alimentos.
  • Experiência com processos de importação.
  • Conhecimento em negociação estratégica e gestão de fornecedores.
  • Familiaridade com normas regulatórias
  • Excel avançado e conhecimento de sistemas ERP.


O que oferecemos

  • Plano de saúde e odontológico
  • Bônus atrelado a metas
  • Refeição no local (café da manhã e almoço)

  • Convênio para desconto em faculdade

Informações adicionais

  • Trabalho 100% presencial em Hortolândia/SP.
  • Horário de segunda a quinta das 7h45 às 17h45 e as sextas das 7h45 às 16h45.

title: Video Editor – Part-Time, Remote
description:
Hours: 20 hours/week

Location: Remote


About Wildfleur

Wildfleur is a fast-growing beauty brand now in over 600 Ulta Beauty stores nationwide within our first months on the market. We’ve earned multiple press mentions and industry awards, including Byrdie’s Best Vitamin C.


Role Overview

The Video Editor will produce short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram and paid ads that are engaging, trend-aware, and aligned with our brand. This role is ideal for someone who loves skincare and beauty, lives in social media culture, and knows how to turn raw footage into polished content that connects with our audience.


Key Responsibilities

  • Transform UGC, influencer clips, and brand shoots into ads that feel authentic, on-trend, and true to our brand identity.
  • Edit raw footage into short, engaging TikTok and Instagram videos.
  • Use eye-catching edits: clean transitions, quick cuts, trending sounds, and storytelling hooks.
  • Add captions, text overlays, music, and effects while keeping the skincare/beauty audience in mind.
  • Ensure videos are exported in the correct formats, resolutions, and aspect ratios for each platform (TikTok, Instagram, Reels, Stories, and paid ads).
  • Stay on top of TikTok & Instagram trends.
  • Keep video assets organized and workflows smooth for ongoing projects.


Qualifications

  • 2–3+ years of experience in video editing, with a strong portfolio of short-form content.
  • Proven track record of creating high-converting paid social media ads and working extensively with UGC.
  • Portfolio examples in beauty, skincare, or cosmetics content are preferred - you understand the audience and the aesthetics.
  • Fluent in English, both spoken and written, for seamless communication and creating platform-native captions.
  • Passionate about cosmetics/skincare culture - you enjoy this world and bring genuine interest into the content.
  • Experience editing with Adobe Premiere Pro / After Effects.
  • Comfortable working in CapCut or mobile-friendly apps when quick, social-native edits are needed.
  • Up-to-date with social media culture, trends, hooks, and viral formats.
  • Strong technical knowledge of video requirements for social media (aspect ratios, frame rates, resolutions, file sizes, export settings).
  • Highly detail-oriented, delivering content that is both on-trend and brand-consistent.
  • A degree in a creative field (film, media, communications, design) or background in filming/content creation is a plus (not required).


Perks

  • Flexible remote schedule.
  • Be part of a supportive and creative team

title: Engenheiro De Ia - Sênior
description:
Descrição da vaga

A posição de AI Software Architect exige uma combinação de visão estratégica e expertise técnica em inteligência artificial, habilidades interpessoais e interesse em atuar próximo ao universo comercial. O foco está na construção de propostas assertivas durante a prospecção e no fortalecimento do relacionamento com clientes, garantindo soluções alinhadas às necessidades de negócio e escaláveis para o futuro.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Colaborar com o Arquiteto de Soluções AI para transformar demandas de negócios em modelos e pipelines de ML/IA escaláveis e eficientes.
  • Implementar modelos de IA, validando performance e garantindo integração nas arquiteturas existentes.
  • Desenvolver pipelines robustos de dados: coleta, processamento, treinamento e deploy de modelos.
  • Integrar soluções de IA em ambientes de produção, alinhando-se às melhores práticas de MLOps (monitoramento, automação e escalabilidade, conhecimento sobre MlFlow ou plataformas como AzureML ou Google VertexAI).
  • Trabalhar próximo ao time comercial e de produto para prototipar e validar propostas, com entregas iterativas e soluções centradas no cliente.
  • Participar ativamente na avaliação de riscos técnicos (performance, escalabilidade, segurança) e colaborar na aplicação de soluções preventivas.
  • Garantir o uso eficiente de ferramentas cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) no desenvolvimento e deploy de soluções.
  • Colaborar na criação de documentação técnica e melhores práticas em alinhamento com o arquiteto e outros stakeholders.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento e deploy de modelos de Machine Learning e Deep Learning.
  • Domínio de linguagens de programação como Python (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, Pandas).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de MLOps e CI/CD (MLflow, Kubeflow, Jenkins, GitLab CI).
  • Sólida experiência com bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL e práticas de otimização de consultas.
  • Experiência com serviços cloud computing (AWS, Azure ou GCP) e containers (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiaridade com arquiteturas de sistemas, pipelines de dados e boas práticas de integração de APIs (REST, GraphQL).


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com AI Generativa e modelos LLMs (ex.: GPT, BERT).
  • Experiência com orquestração em nuvem com ferramentas como airflow, data factory, Databricks pipelines.
  • Experiência em com Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes ou ferramentas como Azure Container Apps (ou relativas).
  • Vivência em ambientes com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Experiência colaborando em projetos com arquitetos de soluções ou times comerciais.

title: Senior Cloud Engineer
description:
About the Company


Sycomp is a global IT services and logistics provider with extensive expertise in cloud, data center, endpoint management and security solutions. Sycomp’s diverse team of consultants and engineers deliver on the company’s mission to tackle challenging global IT projects through its state-of-the-art integration and warehouse centers and global technology partnerships. Headquartered in the heart of Silicon Valley, California, Sycomp has successfully shipped, deployed and managed complex IT projects and supporting assets in more than 150 countries helping its Fortune 500 customers and global partners realize a world without boundaries.



Position Overview:


We are seeking a motivated and results-oriented Senior Cloud Engineer with experience in two or more cloud technologies (AWS or Azure) to join our growing team in a support, engineering, and consulting role. In this role, you will work closely with our senior architects, engineers and consultants to assist clients in designing, implementing, and optimizing cloud-based solutions. This role offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in cloud architecture, develop technical expertise, and contribute to the success of our clients.


What You'll Do:


  • Manage and respond to customer-facing support tickets, ensuring timely resolution of technical issues and maintaining high customer satisfaction.
  • Collaborate with senior architects and consultants to understand client requirements and develop and support scalable cloud-based solutions.
  • Apply best practice framework principles to evaluate and improve client architecture.
  • Apply FinOps best practices to monitor, analyze, and optimize cloud costs, including cost allocation, budget tracking, and implementing cost-saving strategies.
  • Support and assist clients with AI/ML workloads and implementations using cloud provider services such as Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Studio, Azure ML, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, and other AI tools.
  • Assist in designing, implementing, and maintaining cloud infrastructure components such as virtual compute instances (VMs & containers), storage services, databases, and virtual networks (VNet & VPC).
  • Provide technical support to clients, including troubleshooting issues, optimizing performance, and ensuring security best practices.
  • Configure and manage cloud resources, including virtual compute instances, storage services, databases, virtual networks, and more.
  • Develop and document infrastructure as code (IaC) using tools like Amazon CloudFormation & CDK, Azure ARM, Azure Bicap, Google Cloud Deployment Manager, or Terraform.
  • Contribute to DevOps workflows using tools such as Azure DevOps, Google Cloud Deployment and Amazon CodePipeline.
  • Maintain awareness and proficiency on cloud services, features, and best practices to provide expert guidance and support to clients.
  • Contribute to the development of documentation, training materials, and best practices guides for internal and external use.
  • Actively participate in professional development activities to enhance technical skills and knowledge of cloud technologies.


What We're Looking For:


  • Bachelor's or Technology degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • At least three years working in an AWS, Azure or Google Cloud environment.
  • At least one professional-level cloud certification such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer Professional, Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert, Google Professional Cloud Architect, or Google Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer.
  • Strong understanding of core cloud provider services, including compute, networking, storage, database, and security.
  • Understanding of AWS, and Azure framework principles and practices.
  • Understanding of FinOps principles and cloud cost optimization best practices.
  • Basic understanding of AI/ML concepts and familiarity with AI tools and services.
  • Experience with ticketing systems and customer support workflows.
  • Basic knowledge of networking principles and protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP).
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Fluency in English, both written and verbal.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code (IaC) tools.
  • Strong written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.


Bonus Points For:


  • Certifications in more than one cloud provider
  • FinOps Certified Practitioner or experience with cloud cost management tools.
  • Experience with cloud provider AI/ML services.
  • Experience conducting Well-Architected best-practice reviews.
  • Knowledge of DevOps principles and practices.
  • Experience in a technology consulting environment.
  • Experience with multiple cloud platforms.


What We Offer:


  • Collaborative and inclusive work culture with opportunities for growth and advancement.
  • Exciting projects with leading-edge cloud technologies.
  • Continuous learning and professional development opportunities including training and certification programs.


Join our team and embark on a rewarding career journey as a Cloud Engineer, where you will play a vital role in helping our clients succeed in the cloud. Apply now to become part of our innovative and dynamic team!

We are looking for individuals who are not only skilled in project management but also enthusiastic about AI and eager to drive new solutions.

  • To manage AI projects, ensuring successful delivery.
  • To encourage a culture of excellence within the team.
  • To advance AI initiatives through cross-functional collaboration.
  • To engage across functions (SMEs, technical teams, leaderships) to guarantee delivery quality.

  • Project Management: Lead end-to-end project management for AI initiatives, from initiation to successful delivery. Develop project plans, allocate resources, track progress, and ensure timely completion of milestones and deliverables;

title: Senior Full Stack Developer - (Vue / Node.Js)
description:
This is a 100% Remote Independent Contractor Role.


About Equate Media

Equate Media is a growth-focused digital company that builds software and operational systems designed to improve efficiency, support customer engagement, and drive measurable business results. Our teams work closely across engineering, marketing, and operations to solve practical problems, improve workflows, and create systems that make a real impact. We value speed, ownership, adaptability, and people who enjoy building useful things in a fast-moving environment.


About the role

We’re hiring a Senior Full Stack Developer to help strengthen and expand a real-time communications platform used every day by the business. This person will step into an existing production environment, work through active issues, improve platform reliability, and help push new functionality into production quickly.


The work touches both frontend and backend systems tied to inbound and outbound call activity, routing logic, internal buffering, operational tooling, and live user workflows. This is a strong fit for someone who enjoys solving real production problems, working across the stack, and making meaningful contributions without a lot of hand-holding.


Where you’ll make an impact

  • Get up to speed quickly in an existing multi-service production platform
  • Investigate and resolve issues across frontend, backend, and third-party integrations
  • Deliver new features at a high pace while keeping stability and maintainability in mind
  • Improve systems that support real-time call flows, routing behavior, and internal buffering
  • Build and refine interfaces used for live operations and communication workflows
  • Develop backend services, APIs, and platform functionality tied directly to business performance
  • Help improve visibility, reliability, and overall behavior in a live production environment
  • Contribute to engineering decisions and help raise execution standards across the team


Tools and environment

  • Frontend: Vue 3, TypeScript, Vite, Pinia, Vue Router
  • Backend: Node.Js, JavaScript, TypeScript, Express
  • Real-time / Communications: Socket.IO, WebRTC, browser based calling with Twilio/Sinch/similar system
  • Infrastructure / Services: AWS, Redis, RabbitMQ / AMQP, PM2
  • Monitoring / Error Tracking: Sentry


What we’re looking for

  • 5+ years of experience as a full stack software developer
  • Strong backend experience with Node.Js
  • Strong frontend experience with Vue, or strong experience with a modern frontend framework and the ability to work confidently in a Vue codebase
  • Experience working in existing production systems, not only creating from scratch
  • Ability to troubleshoot across the stack and solve real-world issues efficiently
  • Experience shipping features quickly in fast-moving environments
  • Strong instincts around performance, reliability, and maintainability
  • Comfortable taking ownership and operating independently
  • Experience with AWS or other cloud-based production environments
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams


Bonus Points For

  • Telephony, VoIP, call routing, or communications platforms
  • Twilio, Sinch, or similar providers
  • Real-time systems, event-driven architecture, queues, or worker-based services
  • Redis, RabbitMQ, or live operational workflows
  • Improving legacy systems while continuing to ship new functionality
  • Exposure to AI-assisted workflows such as transcription, summarization, or automation


Why this role stands out

This is an opportunity to work on a live platform that supports real operational activity and directly impacts the business. You’ll be solving practical problems, improving systems that people rely on every day, and helping shape what gets built next. If you enjoy working in production systems, fixing meaningful problems, and shipping useful features quickly, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Dba De Oracle
description:

Oracle Database

Comunicação e Consultoria

  • Capacidade de conduzir reuniões técnicas (incidentes, GMUDs, alinhamentos)
  • Experiência em consultoria ou atendimento a múltiplos clientes simultaneamente


Formação

  • Ensino superior completo em:
  • Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia, Estatística ou áreas correlatas


Diferenciais

  • Certificações Oracle (OCA, OCP e OCI)
  • Experiência com outros bancos de dados: MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB


Perfil Comportamental

  • Forte capacidade analítica e resolução de problemas complexos
  • Comunicação clara e objetiva (técnica e com negócio)
  • Organização para atuar com múltiplos clientes e demandas simultâneas
  • Postura consultiva, com foco em melhoria contínua e geração de valor


O que oferecemos

  • Incentivo estruturado à certificação Oracle, incluindo apoio e direcionamento técnico
  • Acesso completo a trilhas de aprendizado em Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)
  • Atuação em ambientes enterprise e projetos de missão crítica , com alta exposição técnica
  • Contato direto com arquiteturas modernas de cloud, dados e alta disponibilidade
  • Remuneração alinhada ao mercado de consultoria, compatível com experiência e performance (modelo PJ)
  • 20 dias de descanso remunerado ao ano
  • Participação nos lucros (PLR) anual
  • Possíveis Bônus por performance

title: Gerente Regional De Vendas
description:
A Fugini é uma empresa brasileira de alimentos, líder nos segmentos de molhos de tomate e vegetais, que iniciou sua trajetória há quase 30 anos na cidade de Monte Alto, interior de São Paulo. Com atuação totalmente voltada ao mercado nacional, seus produtos estão presentes em todas as regiões do país. Atualmente, a companhia opera com duas unidades fabris equipadas com modernos sistemas de automação: uma em Monte Alto (SP) e outra em Cristalina (GO), inaugurada em 2010 e com 33 mil metros quadrados de área construída. Guiada pelos pilares de inovação, sustentabilidade, saudabilidade e excelência, a Fugini foi pioneira no lançamento de embalagens do tipo sachê para a linha de atomatados - uma das mais eficazes e seguras para a preservação dos alimentos - e a primeira no mundo a embalar vegetais nesse formato. Comprometida em oferecer produtos saudáveis e com rótulo limpo (clean label), a empresa não utiliza conservantes artificiais e promoveu a redução de sal, açúcar e gordura na maioria de suas formulações. Seu portfólio inclui molhos de tomate, vegetais em sachês e latas, molhos especiais, condimentos e outros itens desenvolvidos sob rigorosos padrões de qualidade e segurança alimentar. Para saber mais, acesse fugini.Com.Br.


O que buscamos:

  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias comerciais para o canal direto e indireto (pequeno, médio e grandes redes varejistas e atacados de pequeno e médio porte).
  • Planejar e executar campanhas promocionais, garantindo performance e presença no ponto de venda.
  • Acompanhar indicadores de vendas e propor ações para otimização de resultados.
  • Gerenciar relacionamento com clientes e fortalecer parcerias;
  • Analisar contratos comerciais e garantir sua conformidade com as diretrizes da empresa;
  • Identificar oportunidades de crescimento, expansão geográfica e ampliação de portfólio no varejo alimentar.
  • Apoiar na estruturação de equipe, direta e indireta em novas regiões.
  • Liderar, desenvolver e engajar a equipe de Gerentes de Área de Vendas.
  • Residir em Belo Horizonte ou Contagem no estado de Minas Gerais.



Principais Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada na indústria alimentar e no canal direto no estado de Minas Gerais.
  • Domínio de gestão operacional e indicadores de performance.
  • Fluência no uso de ferramentas digitais e aplicativos para gestão e análise.
  • Noções de tributação fiscal no estado de Minas Gerais.
  • Mobilidade para mudança de estado com a família.

title: Engenheiro(A) De Ia Sênior
description:
Sobre a Empresa:

O Clínica Experts é uma plataforma completa de gestão para clínicas de saúde, estética e bem-estar, utilizada diariamente por mais de 7.500 clínicas e 16.000 usuários. Entregamos soluções que integram agenda, prontuário, financeiro, estoque, comunicação omnichannel e inteligência artificial, garantindo eficiência e escala para operações de todos os portes.


Sobre a Oportunidade:

Buscamos um(a) Engenheiro(a) de IA Sênior para atuar diretamente no squad de IA do Clínica Experts, responsável por projetar, evoluir e escalar soluções baseadas em LLMs, agentes inteligentes e sistemas multi-agentes.

Você trabalhará em desafios reais de produção, com alto volume de dados e usuários, construindo soluções que vão desde engenharia de prompts até arquiteturas complexas de agentes com supervisão, memória, ferramentas e observabilidade.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Arquitetar e desenvolver soluções de IA baseadas em LLMs para ambientes de produção em larga escala;
  • Projetar e implementar sistemas de agentes e multi-agentes, incluindo estruturas de supervisor, delegação de tarefas, memória e ferramentas;
  • Desenvolver fluxos complexos utilizando LangChain e LangGraph, aplicando boas práticas de composição, controle e observabilidade;
  • Integrar diferentes provedores de modelos (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, entre outros), escolhendo o melhor modelo para cada caso de uso;
  • Atuar na definição de estratégias de engenharia de prompt, avaliação de respostas, mitigação de alucinações e controle de qualidade;
  • Construir e evoluir pipelines de IA integrados a sistemas backend (APIs, filas, microsserviços);
  • Participar ativamente da inovação do produto através de POCs, MVPs e experimentos controlados;
  • Definir padrõestécnicos, boas práticas e ajudar a elevar o nível do time, atuando como referência técnica em IA.


Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Fundamentos sólidos de IA aplicada e LLMs;
  • Engenharia de prompt (few-shot, chain-of-thought, structured output, function calling);
  • LangChain e seus principais conceitos (chains, tools, memory, retrievers);
  • LangGraph para orquestração de fluxos e agentes complexos;
  • Arquiteturas deagentes autônomos e multi-agentes, incluindo supervisor/worker;
  • Integração com APIs de LLMs (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude);
  • Design de APIs e serviços backend para consumo de IA;
  • Observabilidadeaplicada a IA (logs, métricas, tracing, avaliação de respostas);
  • Conceitos de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), embeddings e vetorização;
  • Mensageria, processamento assíncrono e arquiteturas distribuídas;
  • Experiência prática colocando soluções de IA em produção;
  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software, sendo parte disso com sistemas complexos ou distribuídos.


Você vai se divertir mais se:

  • Tiver paixão por inteligência artificial e acompanhar a evolução rápida do ecossistema de LLMs;
  • Gostar de resolver problemas ambíguos e ainda não totalmente definidos;
  • Curte equilibrar experimentação rápida com engenharia robusta para produção;
  • Tiver senso de dono e se preocupar com impacto real no usuário final.


Será um diferencial se você:

  • Tiver experiência com Node.Js, Python ou TypeScript em sistemas de IA;
  • Já tiver trabalhado com RAG em produção, FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate ou similares;
  • Conhecer técnicas de avaliação automática de LLMs (LLM-as-a-Judge, scoring, CSAT);
  • Possuir experiência com AWS (EC2, S3, filas, escalabilidade);
  • Ter participadoda construção de produtos de IA para usuários finais;
  • Já ter atuado como referência técnica ou líder técnico.


Nossos benefícios:

  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição no cartão Flash;

title: Electrical Engineering Pod Lead - 72132
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Job Overview:

An Electrical Engineering Pod Lead responsible for managing a small team creating simulation-based design problems used to train and evaluate advanced AI models. The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers , and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloud skills to review and support the pod end-to-end.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Team Leadership
  • Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation.
  • Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads.
  • Technical Oversight
  • Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading,
  • Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues.
  • Problem Design (Individual Contribution)
  • Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain.
  • Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions.


Electrical Engineering Subdomains:

You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus:

  • Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation.
  • Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization.
  • RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design.
  • Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design.
  • Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting.


Required Qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline.
  • At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation.
  • At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role.
  • Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments.
  • Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs.
  • Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.G., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar).


Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks.
  • Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation.
  • Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems.


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form .
  • Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form . After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment , which must be completed within 24 hours . Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round .
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements .



After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.Com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Cloud Operations Engineer
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.;
Check Heart Rate Now, aquick and easy wellness monitor;
and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


The Cloud Operations Engineer will provide hands-on operational support across Eightpoint's multi-cloud infrastructure spanning AWS and GCP. This role focuses on maintaining reliability, supporting CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring observability across all environments while enabling the DevOps team to focus on project-driven initiatives. The position reports to the Director of IT & Cybersecurity and works closely with the DevOps and Systems Administration teams.


Key Responsibilities


  • Administer and support AWS infrastructure including EKS clusters, Elastic Beanstalk environments, EC2, S3, CloudFront, RDS, and IAM across a multi-account environment
  • Support GCP workloads, primarily BigQuery pipelines and related data infrastructure.
  • Maintain and troubleshoot self-hosted applications including Airflow, Grafana, and other internal tooling.
  • Support and maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions, including self-hosted runners.
  • Participate in incident response processes — triage, root cause analysis, remediation, and post-incident documentation.
  • Deploy, configure, and maintain logging, monitoring, and alerting tooling (Grafana stack — Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy;
    CloudWatch;
    OneUptime).
  • Manage infrastructure-as-code using Terraform.
  • Participate in on-call rotation providing support across US and offshore time zones.
  • Contribute to documentation in Confluence and maintain runbooks for operational procedures.


Who You Are


  • 5+ years of experience in a cloud operations, DevOps, or infrastructure support role.
  • Strong working knowledge of AWS core services (EKS, Elastic Beanstalk, EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, RDS, CloudFront).
  • Hands-on experience administering containerized workloads (Kubernetes/EKS, Docker).
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions.
  • Demonstrated experience with incident response workflows — detection, escalation, remediation, and RCA.
  • Experience deploying and maintaining observability tooling (logging, metrics, tracing, alerting).
  • Proficiency in Linux administration and shell scripting (Bash, Python).
  • Strong experience with Terraform for infrastructure-as-code.
  • Experience with Atlassian tooling (Jira, JSM, Confluence).

Closir is a UK-based investor relations (IR) support services provider. For over a decade we have been entrusted by blue chip companies around the world to help them achieve their IR objectives due to our intimate knowledge of the global buy-side, our technological expertise, and our close, long-term partnership approach.

The Closir platform is an all-in-one, web-based solution which makes companies much smarter and more effective, by helping them to achieve their IR objectives intelligently and proactively.

share & peer holder tracking;
customisable reports;
and professional-level support.

  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex needs into actionable solutions.
  • Passion for SaaS, fintech, and improving how companies engage with investors.

A large pharmaceutical client is looking for Veeva Support Analyst to join their team. title: Digital Business Analyst
description:
Digital Business Analyst – Shape the Future of Energy Reporting & Operations!


We are recruiting on behalf of a global energy services organisation operating across Gas & Power Services. This programme sits at the heart of operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and customer transparency - replacing fragmented, manual reporting with a scalable digital reporting solution across complex industrial assets.


You’ll join a long-term, high-impact transformation programme focused on power plant operations, Operations & Maintenance (O&M), and performance reporting. This is a discovery-heavy role with real ownership, working directly with senior stakeholders to define what the product should be, before it’s built.


As a Digital Business Analyst, you’ll lead domain discovery, define product capabilities, and act as the bridge between business stakeholders and delivery teams to turn complex operational needs into a clear, scalable digital solution.


Your Role:

You’ll be the bridge between operations, data, and delivery. This is a senior, hands-on role where you’ll rapidly onboard into the Gas & Power Services domain, lead structured discovery, and shape a digital reporting product from the ground up - with ownership through to delivery and value realisation.


What You’ll Do:

  • Lead structured interviews and workshops with domain heads and SMEs to capture current-state (“as-is”) processes, data flows, and pain points
  • Translate business needs into clear product capabilities, outcomes, and success measures
  • Define reporting requirements, data inputs, ownership models, and KPIs across performance, efficiency, safety, environmental, and financial metrics
  • Balance standardisation and configurability across plants, equipment types, and markets
  • Create and maintain product vision, roadmap, capability maps, and a prioritised backlog
  • Define the end-to-end data and reporting strategy - from data collection and validation through to dashboards and customer-facing outputs
  • Work closely with Solution Architects to ensure technical feasibility, scalability, and long-term sustainability
  • Act as the primary bridge between business stakeholders and delivery teams, driving clarity and momentum
  • Lead demos, clarify scope boundaries, and align expectations on custom vs configurable functionality
  • Support planning, estimation, sequencing, and governance across a multi-phase programme
  • Track progress against milestones and help define what success looks like by September 2026


What You Bring:

  • Proven ability to lead discovery independently and bring structure to ambiguous environments
  • Experience working on data-driven products, reporting systems, or analytics platforms
  • Experience with international, enterprise environments
  • Excellent stakeholder management and facilitation skills across senior, operational, and technical audiences
  • Confidence translating complex operational domains into clear, actionable requirements
  • Exposure to energy, utilities, power generation, or industrial operations is highly desirable
  • Familiarity with operational KPIs, asset performance management, and HSE reporting is a strong plus
  • Experience working with dashboards, BI tools, or custom reporting solutions


Why Join the Remobi community:

  • Fully remote B2B / freelance contracts
  • Access to high-impact roles across AI, FinTech, and modern infrastructure
  • A strong community of senior engineers, curated content, and role alerts
  • Work with fast-scaling companies where your impact is visible and valued


Apply today:

If you’re a Digital Business Analyst who thrives in discovery, enjoys shaping products from complex operational environments, and wants to deliver measurable business value in the energy sector - we’d love to hear from you.

title: Assistente Financeiro
description:
Sobre a Ampulheta


A Ampulheta não é um BPO Financeiro. Acreditamos que finanças vão além do pagamento de contas e emissão de notas fiscais. É preciso estratégia, indicadores e planejamento para um crescimento sustentável.

Por isso, somos uma empresa de terceirização que pode assumir até 100% do financeiro dos nossos clientes — da operação à estratégia financeira.

Não somos suporte. Somos o cérebro financeiro por trás de empresas que querem crescer com consistência.

Por quê?

Porque o empresário brasileiro vive apagando incêndio — e nós existimos para devolver a ele o que mais vale: visão, tempo e direção.


O que você irá fazer aqui?


Como assistente financeiro, você será responsável pela execução das rotinas financeiras de uma carteira de clientes B2B — todos negócios reais, com desafios reais.

Você vai operar o financeiro com excelência e ajudar o Gestor de Projetos a tomar decisões estratégicas com base em dados confiáveis e uma execução sem ruído.

Suas responsabilidades:

  • Gestão de contas a pagar e a receber
  • Conciliação bancária e controle de caixa
  • Emissão de notas fiscais e boletos
  • Agendamento de pagamentos
  • Cobrança e contato com inadimplentes
  • Relacionamento direto com clientes
  • Apoio na construção de previsões de fluxo de caixa


Quem estamos procurando?


Não buscamos alguém "comprometido" e "proativo".

Isso é o mínimo.

Buscamos alguém com visão de longo prazo.

Alguém que sabe o impacto de um caixa saudável.

Alguém que resolve antes que vire problema.

E, principalmente, alguém sem a mentalidade de CLT. Aqui somos movidos pela meritocracia.

Se você já trabalhou ou trabalha como PJ, isso será um diferencial.


Requisitos Técnicos (Hard Skills)


  • Experiência com contas a pagar/receber, conciliação e fluxo de caixa
  • Excel intermediário/avançado
  • Domínio de ferramentas como Nibo, Conta Azul, Omie será um baita diferencial.
  • Emissão de notas fiscais, leitura de extratos, organização documental
  • Vivência com empresas de serviços B2B


Requisitos Comportamentais (Soft Skills)


  • Clareza, disciplina e organização no dia a dia
  • Senso de urgência com estabilidade emocional
  • Boa comunicação (simples, direta e profissional)
  • Sede de aprender e de entregar melhor do que foi pedido
  • Capacidade de gerir múltiplos clientes com autonomia


Quem não se encaixa aqui?


  • Quem acha que "tá bom assim"
  • Quem espera alguém dizendo o que fazer o tempo todo
  • Quem não aguenta pressão saudável nem feedback direto
  • Quem trabalha no piloto automático


O que você encontra aqui?


  • Uma rotina com método, clareza e constância
  • Um time que se importa com o cliente e com a entrega
  • Reconhecimento baseado em impacto real — não esforço simbólico
  • Crescimento na prática, não só no discurso
  • Modelo híbrido e autonomia com responsabilidade


Remuneração Mensal?


  • De R$ 4.000,00 a R$ 6.000,00 (progressivo)


Como se candidatar?


Responda as perguntas e aplique sua candidatura


Último aviso:


Se você acredita que rotina financeira bem feita salva empresa — e quer fazer parte de um time que não se contenta com o básico — então vem.

A Ampulheta não é para todo mundo.

É para quem sabe o que está fazendo. E quer fazer melhor ainda.

title: Customer Success Analyst
description:
About us:

Closir is a UK-based investor relations (IR) support services provider. For over a decade we have been entrusted by blue chip companies around the world to help them achieve their IR objectives due to our intimate knowledge of the global buy-side, our technological expertise, and our close, long-term partnership approach.

The Closir platform is an all-in-one, web-based solution which makes companies much smarter and more effective, by helping them to achieve their IR objectives intelligently and proactively.

Closir combines all elements of IR, from high-level strategy (“Who’s investing in my peers?”) to daily workflow (“What topics came up most in my meetings with investors this quarter?”) into one intelligent, user-friendly platform which includes the most comprehensive and up-to-date database of buy-side contacts on the market;
proactive outreach tools;
share & peer holder tracking;
customisable reports;
and professional-level support.


Role Overview:

We are looking for a customer-centric, self-driven individual to join our Customer Success team.


You will manage relationships with IR teams at public companies, guiding them from onboarding through to long-term adoption. You’ll help clients integrate their data, extract insights, and embed Closir into their day-to-day workflows.


You will work closely with Research and Product teams to ensure high-quality data integration, surface client feedback, and improve the experience on Closir.Com.


Responsibilities:


  • Partner with clients to understand their Investor Relations needs and drive adoption of the Closir platform.
  • Act as a trusted advisor, providing strategic insights and support to senior IR teams.
  • Deliver tailored onboarding, training, and consulting sessions.
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to champion client feedback and influence product direction.
  • Build long-lasting relationships that foster retention, growth, and client advocacy.



Qualifications:


  • Background in Investor Relations (in-house or advisory) – you understand the workflows, challenges, and priorities of IR professionals.
  • Experience in consulting, customer success, or client-facing roles where you’ve advised senior stakeholders.
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex needs into actionable solutions.
  • Passion for SaaS, fintech, and improving how companies engage with investors.
  • Fluent in English and Spanish



Why Join Us?


  • Work at the intersection of SaaS, finance, and strategy with a fast-growing, global team.
  • Shape the future of investor relations technology.
  • Opportunity to take ownership and make a measurable impact with clients.
  • Collaborative, ambitious, and supportive culture.



If you’re excited about helping Investor Relations teams thrive with cutting-edge SaaS solutions, we’d love to hear from you.


This job vacancy is open for candidates based out of Latin America.

  • Experiência comFinOps aplicado à observabilidad;

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Você atuará como Analista de TI com foco em integrações e sustentação evolutiva, sendo responsável por garantir a estabilidade e evolução das integrações entre sistemas críticos. Seu papel envolverá tanto a análise técnica e resolução de incidentes quanto a construção e evolução de integrações via APIs e serviços, conectando diferentes plataformas como SAP, Salesforce e outros sistemas corporativos.   • Analisar e resolver incidentes técnicos em ambientes produtivos, atuando com troubleshooting e identificação de causa raiz.
  • Desenvolver, manter e evoluir integrações entre sistemas, utilizando APIs e padrões corporativos.

Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Experiência em análise técnica e sustentação de sistemas, com atuação em ambientes produtivos e resolução de incidentes.
  • Vivência com desenvolvimento e manutenção de integrações entre sistemas, utilizando APIs e serviços web.
  • Experiência com plataformas como SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP, Salesforce e/ou ferramentas de integração como WSO2.

  • Capacidade de atuar de forma hands-on, com autonomia e senso de responsabilidade sobre as entregas.
  • Boa comunicação técnica e habilidade para transitar entre diferentes áreas de TI.

  • Tiver familiaridade com práticas de observabilidade e melhoria contínua.
