title: Emerging Market Trader
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.



Key Responsibilities

FX Trading & Liquidity Management

  • Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.G., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.G., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
  • Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
  • Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
  • Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.


Hedging Strategy & Risk Management

  • Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
  • Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
  • Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization .
  • Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.


Trading Infrastructure & Systems

  • Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including:
  • Automated hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation systems
  • Smart order routing
  • Pricing and risk management tools
  • Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
  • Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .


Market Development

  • Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
  • Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.



Requirements

Experience

  • 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
  • Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies , such as:
  • Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
  • LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
  • Experience working at:
  • Global banks
  • EM FX trading firms
  • Payment / fintech companies
  • Crypto exchanges or market makers
  • Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .


Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of:
  • FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
  • NDF markets and offshore hedging
  • Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
  • Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
  • FX trading systems
  • Hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation platforms
  • Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .


Skills

  • Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments .
  • Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks .
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations .
  • Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources .
  • Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies .
  • Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations .
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments



Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Analista De Growth Marketing | Growth Marketing Analyst
description:
About Downtown Engineers

Downtown Engineers (DWT ENG) is a New York-based MEP (Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing) engineering firm trusted by architecture offices, developers and national brands. Our work spans from franchise rollouts for brands like McDonald's, Domino's and Dunkin' to hospitality projects with Hilton and Hyatt, healthcare and residential buildings across the United States, with a strong focus on New York City.


We're a remote-first team of 20+ people across different countries, with 300+ projects delivered across 16+ sectors. Our culture is grounded in trust, transparency and autonomy, and that's how we communicate too.


About the Opportunity

Downtown is growing and we need someone to build and run the marketing infrastructure that supports it. As a Growth Marketing Analyst, you'll work across three fronts — recurrent clients, referrals and new client acquisition —designing strategies, setting up campaigns, configuring tools and measuring what converts. Your primary focus is on capture and expansion (website, CRM, events, paid media, referral systems, client retention), while supporting the demand layer fed by content and authority.


This role works in close partnership with leadership and sales. You'll think about where to invest and how to grow, then make it happen, connecting marketing efforts to pipeline, testing what works, cutting what doesn't and scaling what proves itself.


Compensation & Structure

  • Full-time contractor (remote)
  • Fixed monthly compensation
  • Please include your compensation expectation in BRL (R$) in your application


What you’ll do


1.Channel oversight & growth

  • Set and track channel-level goals aligned with Downtown's growth priorities: recurrent clients, referrals and new client acquisition
  • Own the day-to-day management and growth of marketing channels — email, paid media, outbound, events and future channels
  • Plan, execute and optimize paid campaigns, including budget management and audience targeting
  • Support the design and execution of outbound and ABM initiatives
  • Optimize website performance as a conversion engine — landing pages, CTAs, user flow and lead capture
  • Monitor organic search performance and identify SEO opportunities to support inbound growth
  • Propose and test new campaigns, formats and acquisition strategies to improve performance


2.CRM & automation

  • Own the marketing layer of the CRM (Zoho) in partnership with sales: segmentation, audience lists, campaign tagging and marketing lifecycle tracking
  • Handle the technical setup and configuration of marketing platforms and integrations
  • Build and manage email marketing flows — nurture sequences, newsletters, re-engagement campaigns and event-driven communications


3.Reporting & optimization

  • Track and report on channel performance, campaign results and growth metrics
  • Run experiments, analyze data and translate findings into actionable improvements
  • Monitor referral and client retention metrics, supporting sales with data-driven insights


Requirements


Must-haves

  • Fluent English (written and spoken). Day-to-day communication is mostly in Portuguese as the Marketing team is entirely Brazilian. However, all official written communication and some of our meetings are conducted fully in English
  • Analytical mindset with comfort in data, dashboards and performance reporting
  • Hands-on execution mindset with high autonomy, curiosity and ownership
  • Experience with B2B marketing and demand generation
  • Working knowledge of CRM platforms (Zoho, HubSpot, Salesforce or similar)
  • Experience building and managing email marketing flows and automation
  • Hands-on experience with paid media ( Ads, Google Ads or similar platforms)


Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with Account-Based Marketing (ABM)
  • Experience with marketing automation tools beyond email (e.G., workflow builders, lead scoring)
  • Familiarity with the architecture, engineering or construction industry


Selection Process

  1. Apply to the opportunity, submitting the form with your CV and English experience
  2. Screening: English and communication assessment (video)
  3. Technical challenge
  4. Interviews with leadership
  5. Offer


Why join Downtown?

  • Role with direct business impact
  • Work with top architects and U.S. brands
  • Fast-moving, low-bureaucracy culture with real autonomy
  • High growth opportunity as the company scales

title: Cloud Ai/Ml Engineer
description:
Looking for an experienced Senior Cloud AI/ML Engineer to lead the automation of complex financial workflows at Prosigliere.


Description

We are seeking a Senior Cloud AI/ML Engineer with a "cloud-first" mindset to join our growing team. In this role, you won't just build models;
you will architect end-to-end intelligent systems that redefine how we handle financial data. You will be responsible for analyzing manual credit request processes and identifying opportunities to automate them using cutting-edge cloud AI services.

The ideal candidate bridges the gap between raw data and actionable business intelligence, building tools that ingest high-stakes data from credit agencies, analyze it through sophisticated AI pipelines, and present it via human-in-the-loop dashboards. You will work closely with engineering leadership to turn manual bottlenecks into scalable, automated cloud solutions.


Responsibilities

  • Process Architecture: Analyze existing credit request workflows to identify automation opportunities using cloud-native AI/ML solutions.
  • Intelligent Data Ingestion: Design and implement processes utilizing Document Intelligence (OCR/Form parsing), and Web Search integration to gather and structure fragmented data.
  • Third-Party Data Synthesis: Build tools to ingest and analyze complex results from credit agencies (e.G., D&B, Experian, Equifax ) to drive automated decision-making.
  • Custom Tooling: Develop custom software bridges to fill gaps between standard cloud AI services and specific business requirements.
  • Human-in-the-Loop Systems: Create intuitive dashboards that visualize AI-driven analysis, allowing human reviewers to audit and approve automated recommendations.
  • Cloud Deployment: Deploy and maintain robust MLOps pipelines in a cloud environment, ensuring high reliability and security for sensitive financial data.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Communicate technical AI concepts to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate with backend teams to ensure seamless data flow.


Technology Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering with a heavy focus on Cloud AI/ML implementations.
  • Cloud-First Expertise: Proven experience with Vertex AI (GCP) , Azure AI , or AWS SageMaker , specifically utilizing high-level AI services (Document AI, Search/Discovery, etc.).
  • Data Integration: Proficiency in building API integrations and data pipelines that handle structured and unstructured data from external financial vendors.
  • Python Mastery: Expert-level Python skills, including experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar frameworks for building agentic AI workflows.
  • Visualization: Experience building data dashboards using tools like Streamlit, Looker, or custom React-based frontend components.
  • Security Mindset: Deep understanding of handling sensitive PII (Personally Identifiable Information) within cloud environments.


Profile Requirements

  • Solution Architect Mentality: Ability to look at a manual business process and map it to a technical AI roadmap.
  • Independent Problem Solver: A self-starter who can build "the bridge" when a standard out-of-the-box tool doesn't exist.
  • Strong Communication: Ability to explain why an AI made a specific recommendation to stakeholders.
  • Agile Learner: A commitment to staying current with the rapid pace of LLM, RAG, and Agentic AI developments.
  • AI Tooling: Proficiency with AI-first engineering approaches and tooling is a plus. If you are familiar with the Cognition platform with Windsurf and Devin, that is even better.
  • Certifications: Google, Azure or AWS Cloud AI certifications are a big plus!

  • Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives.

  • 8+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, Developer Experience , or related engineering roles.
  • Strong hands-on experience with LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer tooling in production or enterprise settings.
  • Strong Python development skills for automation and AI workflow integrations.

Preferred / Nice to Have

  • Vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, OpenSearch, etc.)

title: Technical Product Owner
description:
ABOUT US

Syniti , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.

Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.

Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.


Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.


THE ROLE

We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.



What You’ll Do

  • Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.
  • Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.
  • UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP.
  • Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.
  • Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior.
  • Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.



WHAT IT TAKES

  • The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).
  • The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.
  • The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.
  • The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams.
  • The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.
  • The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.


Key Skills

  • Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals.
  • Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules.
  • AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic.
  • Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment.
  • Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity.
  • Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.
  • Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment.


Be fully aligned with our core values:

Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.

Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.

Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.

Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.


By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.


WHAT WE OFFER

  • Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.
  • Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
  • Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
  • Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all.
  • Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
  • An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued.


OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION

At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.

title: Senior Content Manager
description:
As a Senior Content Manager, you will play a key role in supporting MoveUp Media’s growth by owning the operational and strategic execution of content across our website portfolio. You will take ownership of content performance and strategy across our websites, while leading day-to-day content operations and working closely with SEO and cross-functional teams. You will be responsible for turning content and SEO strategies into measurable results, while ensuring high-quality standards across multi-language teams and markets.


This role contributes directly to the CORE department’s objectives by supporting the growth, stability, and diversification of the business through content performance, strong processes, and effective collaboration. You will act as the main point of ownership for content quality and delivery, working closely with SEO, Product, and cross-functional teams.


To be more specific, you will:


  • Lead and develop the content strategy for our flagship, multi-language websites across multiple markets
  • Manage content workflows and ensure consistent, high-quality output across all sites
  • Oversee content quality, structure, and standards across our portfolio
  • Work proactively with content teams to define and implement content checklists and best practices
  • Collaborate closely with SEO, Tech, Design, and Product teams to ensure content and SEO best practices are followed
  • Ensure all SEO and content checks are completed ahead of website launches or redesigns
  • Regularly review websites to identify issues, suggest improvements, and support teams with implementation
  • Monitor content performance and report progress and key initiatives to senior stakeholders
  • Ensure content meets compliance and regulatory requirements and oversee necessary updates
  • Stay up to date with market trends, best practices, and iGaming innovations
  • Support hiring and team development (mentoring) in collaboration with Talent Acquisition and HR.


The ideal profile


We’re looking for a Senior Content Manager ready to step into a Lead role — someone who takes ownership of content performance, works independently, and collaborates closely with SEO to drive results.


You are someone who:


  • Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role
  • Has iGaming experience (a strong plus, not a must)
  • Has a background in journalism, communications, or a related field (a plus)
  • Has an excellent command of English and a strong eye for content quality and consistency
  • Is comfortable reviewing and optimising content rather than writing it


You bring strong CM fundamentals:


  • High level of autonomy and strong task prioritisation skills
  • Ownership mindset over site and content performance
  • Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into clear actions
  • Strategic thinking and the ability to plan toward defined goals
  • Experience working with CMS platforms


You work well with others and think ahead:


  • Collaborative approach, especially when working with SEO teams
  • Proactive in sharing ideas, flagging issues, and suggesting improvements
  • Open to experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement
  • Positive attitude with a growth mindset and leadership potential


Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.


Next steps in the process ✅


  • 1rst Interview with your future manager to make sure you meet the role’s requirements
  • 2nd interview with HR to better understand who you are and make sure there is a cultural fit with MoveUp Media
  • Last step: a proposition for us to start working together!


What’s in it for you


  • A full time remote work environment.
  • A flexible schedule and paid time off. We measure results , not hours.
  • Competitive salary, depending on your level of seniority in the role and your location
  • Development opportunities. As a startup with rapid growth, there are a lot of possibilities that can arise and we are committed to accompany our team members in their career path.
  • Yearly get together with the team to connect, work and have fun . We strive to find good spots for everyone to enjoy the stay!

We are seeking an experienced AI Engineer to drive AI-first engineering practices and enable developer productivity at scale. title: Senior Backend Engineer (Golang)
description:
OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICA


Title: Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations

Company: Fulcrum SaaS

Location: Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required)

Type: Full-time

Level: Senior / Staff

Compensation: USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location


About Fulcrum SaaS

Fulcrum SaaS is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant SaaS environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable.

Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.


The Role

We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers.

You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars.

You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.


What You’ll Do

  • Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements.
  • Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery.
  • Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/BigQuery or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation.
  • Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise.
  • Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure.
  • Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.


What We’re Looking For (Must-Haves)

  • 5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better).
  • Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes.
  • Deep working knowledge of Go’s concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity.
  • Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/BigQuery strongly preferred;
    Cassandra, DynamoDB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable.
  • Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures.
  • Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like.
  • Multi-tenant SaaS experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure.
  • Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable.
  • Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate.
  • Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).


Strong Nice-to-Haves

  • Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic).
  • A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks.
  • Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches.
  • Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.


What We Offer

  • Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM.
  • Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices.
  • Direct access to leadership;
    your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented.
  • A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.


How to Apply

Please apply through with your CV (English) and a brief note highlighting:

  • Your experience with Go in production.
  • The most demanding data/throughput system you have owned.
  • Your country of residence and preferred start date.

You can also include links to GitHub, technical blogs, or talks if available.

Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.




Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:


  • Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.

Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo.

Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores.

title: Business Development Manager, Brazil
description:
About ASTERRA


ASTERRA is the global leader in satellite-based infrastructure intelligence. The company utilizes L-band Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) data and proprietary algorithms to detect soil moisture and underground leaks. This technology empowers water utilities, government agencies, and infrastructure sectors- including roads, railways, dams, and levees- to make data-driven decisions.

Brazil is a Level 1 Platinum Territory and represents one of ASTERRA’s most strategic markets within LATAM. The Brazilian water and wastewater sector presents significant opportunities for infrastructure monitoring and leak detection solutions, making the territory a key growth engine for the company.


About the Job


ASTERRA is seeking a Business Development Manager for Brazil to lead and expand the company’s commercial presence in the Brazilian market.

In this role, you will own the development of ASTERRA’s partner ecosystem and market strategy across Brazil. You will work closely with resellers, integrators, consulting firms, and key infrastructure stakeholders to drive new business opportunities and expand existing accounts.


This is a field-oriented role combining strategic leadership with hands-on operational execution . The role requires building strong relationships with partners and water utilities, managing complex sales cycles, supporting project implementation, and ensuring successful delivery and results for customers. The position requires strong autonomy, analytical thinking, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams in Israel and internationally.


Key Responsibilities


Territory Strategy & Ecosystem Development


  • Define and execute the Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy for Brazil .
  • Map and analyze the Brazilian infrastructure and water utility ecosystem to identify and recruit strategic partners.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with resellers, system integrators, consulting firms, and service providers operating in the water and infrastructure sectors.
  • Translate local market insights into actionable growth plans to win new customers and expand existing accounts.


Commercial Leadership & Sales Execution


  • Lead discovery meetings, opportunity development, and commercial negotiations with partners and end customers.
  • Build executive-level relationships with key stakeholders within water utilities, infrastructure operators, and partner organizations.
  • Drive collaborative co-selling activities with partners while coordinating internal resources to support deal progression.
  • Develop and maintain a strong partner-generated sales pipeline aligned with territory revenue goals.


Partner Enablement & Ecosystem Management


  • Support partner onboarding, commercial enablement, and product training.
  • Ensure partners understand ASTERRA’s technology, value proposition, and use cases.
  • Monitor partner activity and performance, focusing on strengthening relationships with high-performing partners while optimizing the partner portfolio.
  • Provide training and knowledge-sharing to partners, customers, and ecosystem stakeholders.


Project Oversight & Value Realization


  • Maintain a hands-on approach to project execution, supporting customers and partners throughout project delivery and implementation.
  • Monitor project performance, results, and customer outcomes to ensure successful adoption of ASTERRA’s solutions.
  • Work proactively with partners and customers to improve results, align expectations, and identify opportunities for expansion.
  • Maintain strong post-sale engagement to support upselling and long-term customer relationships.


Cross-Functional Collaboration


  • Collaborate closely with Product, Marketing, and Operations teams to align global resources with local market opportunities.
  • Share field insights and market intelligence to support product development and strategic planning.
  • Maintain effective communication with international teams while operating remotely across time zones.


What You’ll Need


Experience


  • 5-7+ years of experience in Channel Sales, Business Development, or Commercial roles .
  • Direct experience in the water, wastewater, utilities, or infrastructure sectors in Brazil is required .
  • Strong knowledge of the Brazilian water and wastewater market and familiarity with public water utilities.


Network & Market Knowledge


  • Existing professional network within water utilities, infrastructure operators, government agencies, or related sectors is highly desirable.


Territory Management


  • Proven experience managing a field territory in Brazil and driving commercial growth through partners and direct engagement.


Languages


  • Native or fluent Portuguese and professional English are mandatory.
  • Spanish is an advantage.


Commercial & Strategic Skills


  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex sales processes involving multiple stakeholders and partners.
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate technical solutions into business value.


Remote Collaboration


  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while maintaining strong collaboration with international teams, particularly with colleagues based in Israel.


Travel


  • Willingness to travel across Brazil as required.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)


  • Revenue: Achievement of quarterly and annual revenue targets generated through partners and direct sales.
  • Pipeline Health: Development and maintenance of strong pipeline coverage within the territory.
  • Partner Development: Growth in the number of active and productive partners in Brazil.
  • Retention & Expansion: Customer retention and expansion through upselling and cross-selling opportunities.


Why Join us?


  • Impact : Work with breakthrough satellite-based SAR technology that helps conserve critical resources and protect infrastructure worldwide.
  • Ownership Culture : Join a high-performance organization built on accountability, collaboration, and customer obsession.
  • Strategic Market : Lead ASTERRA’ s expansion in one of the company’s most important global markets.
  • Growth Opportunity : Be part of a scaling technology company turning advanced satellite data into real-world impact.
  • Compensation : Competitive compensation package including performance-based incentives.


*Please ensure that your resume is submitted in English.

title: Senior Salesforce Developer
description:
Senior Salesforce Developer

Brazil


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Developer with Data Cloud experience to support a strategic initiative focused on reducing customer churn by integrating and enriching customer data across multiple platforms. This role will work closely with the Salesforce Architect, data engineering teams, and cross-functional partners to ingest, unify, and expose data within Salesforce CRM and Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud).

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Lead end-to-end ingestion and mapping of customer data from Salesforce CRM, Siebel, Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, and churn model outputs into Salesforce Data 360;
  • Design, build, and maintain identity and account unification rules to produce accurate customer matching and golden records;
  • Create scalable, repeatable pipelines for ingestion, transformation, mapping, and controlled promotion across environments (including Data 360 data kits);
  • Enrich Salesforce CRM records with Data 360 attributes and analytics/model insights (e.G., churn) using related lists, dynamic related lists, and custom UI components;
  • Support CRM data strategy during the Siebel-to-Salesforce migration, prioritizing Salesforce CRM as the system of engagement as adoption increases;
  • Develop and support APIs and integration services for secure internal consumption of Data 360 and CRM data;
    partner with architecture/engineering on integration patterns and implement ETL when native connectors don’t meet requirements;
  • Monitor and optimize Data 360 credit consumption to balance cost, performance, and SLAs;
  • Enable businessteams to use enriched customer data for segmentation, activation, and analytics use cases;
  • Document processes, standards, and runbooks;
    contribute to shared enablement resources to drive adoption and operational continuity.

Essential Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce development;
  • Strong proficiency in: Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce core data model, Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP/Bulk), and integration design patterns;
  • Hands-on experience with Data ingestion and harmonization, Identity resolution and unification rules, Data kits and environment promotion, Large-scale data processing;
  • Experience connecting Salesforce Data Cloud/Data 360 to external systems (Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, Siebel, or similar), including when to use native connectors vs. custom integrations;
  • Experience withETL processes and/or tools (e.G., Informatica, MuleSoft, Talend, Databricks);
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams;
  • Strong technical communication skills, able to translate complex concepts for architects, engineers, business users, and leadership;
  • Advanced English to be in contact with customer representative on a daily basis.

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, especially data activation and segmentation;
  • Experience withSiebel CRM integration and/or data migration;
  • Knowledge of telecom customer data, churn analytics, or Customer 360 implementations;
  • Familiarity with Azure data engineering and Microsoft Fabric connector limitations;
  • Understanding of scalable deployment pipelines and DevOps tooling (Git, CI/CD).

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

Somos a ORÍGEO e viemos construir uma relação próxima que simplifique o dia a dia da lavoura, lado a lado do produtor sendo seu parceiro da semente à comercialização, visando uma agricultura produtiva, sustentável e em constante evolução.


PROPÓSITO DO CARGO

Nesta posição, atuará como peça-chave na consolidação e análise das informações financeiras do grupo, com foco em garantir a integridade, conformidade e qualidade das demonstrações financeiras. Será responsável por suportar os processos de auditoria externa e interna, além de contribuir na elaboração de relatórios gerenciais e no fortalecimento dos controles internos. O profissional atuará em estreita colaboração com outras áreas da companhia e suas unidades de negócio. Necessário capacidade analítica e crítica para que analise, entenda e explique as variações entre P&L e BS, mudanças significativas nos processos dos negócios e parâmetros contábeis.


RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Apoiar a liderança na consolidação das demonstrações financeiras (DFs) em conformidade com as normas contábeis brasileiras (BR GAAP) e internacionais (IFRS);
  • Atuar como principal interface com auditorias externas e internas, garantindo o fornecimento de informações e documentos de forma precisa e tempestiva;
  • Apoiar no processo de fechamento contábil mensal, trimestral e anual, realizando análises críticas de variações e assegurando a consistência dos dados;
  • Desenvolver e acompanhar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) financeiros e operacionais;
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos processos de controladoria e propor soluções que aumentem a eficiência e conformidade;
  • Garantir a aderência às políticas internas e às normas regulatórias vigentes;
  • Participar de projetos estratégicos e de integração de sistemas, quando necessário.


QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Formação superior em Ciências Contábeis (CRC Ativo);
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA será considerado um diferencial;
  • Inglês nível intermediário (escrita e leitura);
  • Sólida experiência na área contábil/controladoria;
  • Experiência comprovada no atendimento à auditoria (Big Four);
  • Conhecimento avançado em normas contábeis (CPC, IFRS, USGAAP será diferencial);
  • Domínio de Excel e sistemas ERP (SAP).


Nós, da ORÍGEO, acreditamos que um time com diversidade constrói grandes histórias. Por isso, se você é uma Pessoa com Deficiência e se identificou com essa vaga, participe do nosso processo seletivo!

title: Consultor(A) De Aplicações E Vendas - Offshore - Rj

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

Reconhecemos a importância do bem-estar dos colaboradores. Oferecemos convênios médico, odontológico, farmácia e Wellhub (Gympass);
seguro de vida;
cooperativa de crédito;
previdência privada;
reconhecimento e muito mais. Nossa cultura de apoio às nossas pessoas oferece grupos de recursos e programa de assistência aos colaboradores, além de licença parental estendida (materna e paterna) por ser Empresa Cidadã.

title: Account Manager
description:
As an Account Manager for Brazil , you'll join our passionate and supportive team characterised by our ambition and team spirit. You'll have the freedom to work independently while fostering strong collaboration with our content and product departments.


You'll be responsible for driving the entire sales and success cycle in the iGaming market, from initial engagement to maximizing long-term results. Managing key client relationships, driving sales growth, and ensuring customer satisfaction within these specific regions. This role requires a proactive approach to identifying opportunities, understanding client needs, and delivering tailored solutions that drive mutual success.


Specifically, your role will involve:


  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with key clients, including sports betting operators, casinos, online gaming platforms, and other relevant stakeholders.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for key client accounts, managing all aspects of the client relationship and serving as their trusted advisor.
  • Understand clients' business objectives, market trends, and regulatory requirements specific to the English speaking markets to effectively position our gambling products and services.
  • Collaborate with internal sales, marketing, and product development teams to customize solutions and address client needs within these regions.
  • Proactively identify opportunities for upselling additional products/services and expanding client accounts.
  • Prepare and deliver compelling sales presentations, proposals, and business cases to key clients within these regions.
  • Monitor and analyze sales performance, market trends, and competitor activities to identify opportunities for growth and optimization within key accounts.
  • Attend industry events, conferences, and trade shows worldwide to network with key clients and stay informed about industry insights and developments.
  • Provide timely and accurate reports on key account performance, sales activity, and revenue forecasts within these regions to management.
  • Stay up-to-date on gambling regulations, compliance standards, and responsible gaming practices to ensure adherence and mitigate risks.


The ideal profile


We're on the lookout for someone who not only shares our values and ambitions but also envisions growing alongside MoveUp Media. As a dedicated team player, you embody fair play, transparency, agility, and an unstoppable drive. You're the perfect fit for our team if you:


  • Have outstanding written and verbal communication skills in Brazilian Portuguese and English.
  • Understand gambling products, platforms, and regulations in specific regions.
  • Drive change and support accounts in the iGaming industry with your sales skills.
  • Be ambitious, adaptable, and thrive in fast-paced environments.
  • Focus on exceeding sales targets and driving revenue growth.
  • Bring experience in iGaming strategy, sales, or affiliate management.
  • Excel in building and maintaining strong relationships with partners.
  • Possess excellent communication and negotiation skills.
  • Show active listening, resilience, and persistence.
  • Demonstrate strong problem-solving abilities and effective task coordination.
  • Excel in time management, organization, and planning.
  • Manage multiple accounts and tasks simultaneously.
  • Use analytical skills and a data-driven mindset for decision-making.
  • Thrive in teamwork and adapt well to evolving environments.
  • Be open to occasional travel for client meetings and industry events.


Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.


Next steps in the process ✅


  • First Interview: A conversation with your future manager to ensure you meet the role’s requirements.
  • Second Interview: A chat with HR to understand you better and ensure a cultural fit with MoveUp Media.
  • Final Step: A proposition for us to start working together!


What’s in it for you


  • Remote Work Environment: Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely full-time.
  • Flexible Schedule: We measure results , not hours, and offer paid time off.
  • Development Opportunities: As a rapidly growing startup, we offer numerous possibilities for career advancement and support your career path.
  • Team Gatherings: Annual team get-togethers to connect, work, and have fun . We strive to find enjoyable spots for everyone.
  • Wellness Fund: €1,000 per year dedicated to your professional development, sports, or cultural events of your choice.


MoveUp Media

  • Experiência prática em desenvolvimento assistido por IA, com uso de ferramentas como Cursor, GitHub Copilot ou Replit;

  • Experiência com APIs escaláveis, microsserviços e sistemas distribuídos com containers (Docker) e orquestração;

Somos uma empresa norte-americana de cibersegurança que já protegeu mais de 1.000 organizações nos setores financeiro, telecomunicações, cloud, mídia e streaming, jurídico e saúde e que confiam na UPX para manter suas operações no ar 24/7/365.

title: Senior Engineer - Device Orchestration
description:
At Lenovo, we are driven by a bold vision to deliver Smarter Technology for All. Our mission is to develop transformative technologies that foster a more inclusive, trustworthy, and sustainable digital society. Through the design and engineering of the world’s most comprehensive portfolio of smart devices and infrastructure, we are also leading innovation in device management and orchestration—creating better experiences and opportunities for millions of devices globally.


Our robust orchestration solution provides deep insights into device health and performance directly from a centralized dashboard. Key capabilities include:



  • Identification of top crash types and performance-impacting applications
  • Enforcement of device security standards
  • Scheduling of system updates and software patches
  • Delivery of proactive insights and recommended remediations
  • Join us in shaping the future of intelligent device management and defining the next generation of smarter technology.


About this role


Lenovo’s Cloud and Software Division is expanding its Device Management and Orchestration capabilities at our Brazil locations. We are seeking a Senior Engineer / Technical Lead to drive the design, development, and evaluation of our intelligent endpoint management platform. This platform monitors, manages, and optimizes device fleets across diverse operating systems using cloud-native services and internal and external vendor-specific plugins.


This role combines deep engineering expertise with leadership in cloud-native architecture, leveraging technologies such as Angular, Java, Spring Boot, C#, Kafka, and AWS.


Key Responsibilities


  • Engineering & Architecture
  • Lead the design and implementation of device orchestration workflows using microservices architecture.
  • Develop secure, scalable, and resilient services for remote device management across multi-vendor platforms.
  • Integrate with cloud infrastructure (AWS VPC, EC2, MongoDB, Postgres) and client-side components.
  • Ensure secure communication via trusted partner protocols and encrypted data flows.
  • Mentor engineers through design reviews, low-level design ownership, and security readiness.
  • Cloud-Native Development
  • Champion architectural reuse and drive platform integration for long-term scalability.
  • Modernize legacy systems and reduce complexity in device management services.
  • Propose and lead development of reusable services/components across the cloud and software organization.
  • Build and deploy services on AWS using EC2, S3, Lambda, and build architecture of managing docking stations and monitors.
  • Implement Kafka-based messaging and MQTT brokers for real-time device telemetry.
  • Use Keycloak for authentication and manage access across distributed services.
  • Collaboration & Leadership
  • Mentor engineers and lead solution reviews to ensure high-quality implementation.
  • Collaborate with product managers, cloud architects, and security teams to align technical execution with business goals.
  • Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Lead and deliver complex features in device management with exceptional quality and velocity.


Required Skills & Experience


  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 10+ years of software engineering experience, with 5+ years in technical leadership roles.


Strong proficiency in:


  • Frontend: Angular
  • Backend: Java, Spring Boot, C#
  • Messaging: Kafka, MQTT
  • Cloud: AWS (Azure is a plus)
  • Experience with microservices, secure coding, CI/CD, and cloud-native architecture.

Our work spans from franchise rollouts for brands like McDonald's, Domino's and Dunkin' to hospitality projects with Hilton and Hyatt, healthcare and residential buildings across the United States, with a strong focus on New York City.


We're a remote-first team of 20+ people across different countries, with 300+ projects delivered across 16+ sectors. Our culture is grounded in trust, transparency and autonomy, and that's how we communicate too.

Downtown is growing and we need someone to build and run the marketing infrastructure that supports it. As a Growth Marketing Analyst, you'll work across three fronts — recurrent clients, referrals and new client acquisition —designing strategies, setting up campaigns, configuring tools and measuring what converts. Your primary focus is on capture and expansion (website, CRM, events, paid media, referral systems, client retention), while supporting the demand layer fed by content and authority.


This role works in close partnership with leadership and sales. You'll think about where to invest and how to grow, then make it happen, connecting marketing efforts to pipeline, testing what works, cutting what doesn't and scaling what proves itself.

  • Set and track channel-level goals aligned with Downtown's growth priorities: recurrent clients, referrals and new client acquisition
  • Own the day-to-day management and growth of marketing channels — email, paid media, outbound, events and future channels

3.Reporting & optimization

Requirements


Must-haves

  • Fluent English (written and spoken). Day-to-day communication is mostly in Portuguese as the Marketing team is entirely Brazilian. However, all official written communication and some of our meetings are conducted fully in English

Nice-to-haves

title: International Customer Technical Service-Technical Account Manager-Brazil
description:
Job Description

Technical Account Manager (TAM) is a customer service interface role. TAM is responsible for the stability of the customer's cloud business and the overall growth, quality, and satisfaction of customer service relationships. TAM works closely with the Alibaba Cloud team to ensure that customer requests, issues, and features receive timely attention and priority handling.


Standardized Operations

- Maintain the stability of the customer's cloud platform through risk governance, product changes and upgrades, and emergency response to faults;

- Continuously optimize resources and performance to help customers improve cloud efficiency;

- Drive the continuous improvement of cloud product operation capabilities from the user's perspective, reduce the difficulty of cloud platform operations, and enhance customers' ability to maintain their cloud platform.


Standardized Cloud Migration

- Assist customers in business migration to the cloud, make good use of the cloud by providing technical services such as application/big data architecture design, database localization, application/big data performance tuning, data governance, and data platform construction, and offer best practices and solutions for cloud products in industry applications.


Cloud Optimization (Public Cloud)

- Build and optimize system architecture, establish business disaster recovery capabilities, design and implement monitoring systems, and guide regular disaster recovery drills to improve the stability and reliability of cloud-based business, ensuring system performance and response speed under high concurrency;

- Implement intelligent monitoring and early warning to enhance customer business efficiency and user experience.


Standardized Technical Operations

- Provide comprehensive cloud technology support, cost optimization, maturity assessment and consulting, compliance and security reinforcement services through standardized technical operation capabilities to enhance the efficiency and security of customers' cloud business.


Expert Services

- Provide customers with best practices, solution consulting, and services for Alibaba Cloud intelligent products;

- Combine customercloud usage scenarios to help customers improve cloud product operation and usage skills through tools to assist customers in successfully migrating to cloud.


Job Requirement

- Over 5 year of experience in solution design, architecture, backend development, delivery, or operations for large-scale internet applications or enterprise-level systems in industries such as internet or finance

- Possesses a technical background with hands-on experience in developing or operating large-scale applications based on cloud products

- Possesses technical understanding and hands-on experience in one or more domains including cloud-native technologies, big data, databases, networking, and middleware.

- Masters the underlying architecture of core products within the supported business lines.

- Proficient in the specialized technical competencies required by the supported business lines.

- Understands cross-product system architectures and is capable of performing solution design or troubleshooting based on this expertise.

- Accurately identifies and categorizes customers and key stakeholders, establishing tailored response strategies for different customer segments.

- Creates a constructive communication atmosphere, focuses on key discussion points, listens effectively, and articulates messages clearly.

- Demonstrates strong service orientation—commits to fully resolving customer issues from start to finish and ensures high customer satisfaction.

- In specific domains, capable of engaging in prepared, professional communication with senior-level client executives.

- Possesses operations technology management capabilities, capable of conducting comprehensive reviews of customer business architectures and providing cloud best-practice recommendations.

- Acts as the primary owner for customer technical projects, including operational assurance, technical transformation, and stack migration initiatives.

- Assists customers in resolving complex technical issues and demonstrates strong capability to drive technical execution on the customer side.

- Exhibits systematic and holistic solution design and architecture skills, able to deliver reliable solutions in complex technical environments.

- Capable of decomposing complex technical challenges into manageable components, formulating integrated technical assessments and resolution strategies.

- Familiar with practical case studies across common business scenarios;
able to tailor optimization solutions—including high availability enhancement, cloud operations assurance, capacity planning, architectural refinement, disaster recovery setup, cost evaluation and optimization—based on customer-specific contexts, proactively identify risks, and effectively implement tailored solutions.

title: Investment Team Analyst / Intern
description:
Company Description


Upstream Capital is a tactical investor focused on growth-stage technology companies, deploying both debt and equity to scale businesses. Headquartered in São Paulo, Brazil, the firm has a global reach, with a proven track record of investing over $200 million in over 25 tech companies across Latin America, the Bay Area, and other regions. With deep expertise in the tech sector, Upstream Capital operates as a comprehensive finance platform leveraging knowledge, networking, data, and AI to drive success. The company is committed to partnering with innovative businesses, finding creative solutions to complex challenges, and aligning success between investors and investees for long-term growth.


Role Description


The role is designed for someone who is deeply curious about how companies operate, how their economics work, and what are the patterns that makes some of them thrive. The Intern will be exposed to the full investment process and encouraged to think critically about markets and capital allocation.

Beyond analytical work, we value people who enjoy engaging with the broader investment landscape. The role involves listening, asking good questions, forming independent views, and contributing ideas to internal discussions. Curiosity and judgment matter as much as technical skills.

Upstream operates in a lean, high-ownership environment. Interns are expected to take responsibility for their work, explore opportunities proactively, and learn by doing. We look for individuals who are comfortable navigating ambiguity and who see feedback and mistakes as part of the learning process.

Candidates may come from any academic background. What matters is intellectual rigor, attention to detail, and a consistent pattern of high personal standards. Prior exposure to finance, consulting, or technology is a plus, but not a prerequisite.


Qualifications


  • Proficiency in Financial Modeling and deep understanding of Finance principles
  • Ability to communicate insights effectively through reports and presentations
  • Experience in, or knowledge of, the technology sector is a plus
  • Fluency in English;
    proficiency in Portuguese and/or Spanish is strongly preferred
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field


About Us

Formerly known as Upload Ventures Growth, Upstream has the goal of becoming a platform for lifecycle investing in growth and late-stage technology companies. The firm builds on Upload’s track record of supporting global founders and leverages its experience in venture capital, technology, and data to identify, underwrite, and scale high-performing businesses.


Upstream operates with a lean structure and a hands-on approach. We value analytical rigor, operational discipline, and the ability to execute with precision in fast-paced environments.

LLM Evaluation Test:

title: Executivo(A) De Vendas Pleno -Susep
description:
Somos a Seguros Unimed, a Seguradora do Sistema Unimed, uma empresa criada por médicos e que tem o cooperativismo na essência. Cuidamos das instituições e das pessoas, para que possam viver bem o presente e planejar o futuro com segurança. Trabalhamos todos os dias para oferecer soluções completas, que potencializem novos negócios. E estamos ao lado dos nossos clientes na hora em que mais precisam. Acreditamos que a cooperação nos conecta para crescermos juntos.


Pelo 7º ano consecutivo, a Seguros Unimed integra o ranking dos Lugares Mais Incríveis para Trabalhar 2025 , da FIA e do Estadão. E este ano, alcançamos o patamar MÁXIMO: somos O MAIS INCRÍVEL!


O que oferecemos nessa Jornada:

  • Remuneração compatível com o mercado;
  • PPR - Programa de Participação nos Resultados;
  • Vale Refeição eAlimentação;
  • Vale transporteou desconto em estacionamento;
  • Seguro Saúde;
  • Convênio Odontológico;
  • Seguro de Vida e Acidentes Pessoais;
  • Previdência Privada;
  • Assistência a Viagens;
  • Garantia Funeral;
  • Auxílio Creche ou Babá;
  • Convênio com farmácia;
  • Convênio com academia;
  • Happy Day - um dia de folga no aniversário.



Além disso, você encontra por aqui:

  • Trilha de desenvolvimento;
  • Plataforma exclusiva com treinamentos;
  • Diversas parcerias e descontos pela região.


No seu dia-a-dia:


  • Realizar as atividades de vendas corporativas, planos e iniciativas de gestão e relacionamento comercial com clientes diferenciados com médio impacto financeiro, realizando prospecções e ofertas, entendendo necessidades realizando contatos e visitas para mapeamento e/ou monitoramento da qualidade e grau de satisfação dos produtos adquiridos da Seguros Unimed, buscando e avaliando informações que permitam a criação, atendimento a novas demandas e promoção de alterações em contratos/condições comerciais e/ou no desenvolvimento/produção de produtos, assegurando nível de satisfação e continuidade de contratos;
  • Realizar visitas aos clientes, identificar e oferecer através de análise do potencial de negócios do cliente, novos serviços, buscando alavancar negócios de pós vendas, desenvolvendo soluções para renovações e up grade das contas ativas da Cia;
  • Organizar toda a demanda ou processos advindos do escritório regional, corretoras ou a pessoa jurídica, sendo resolutivo, revendo prazos, rotinas e assegurando treinamentos quando identificada a necessidade de melhorias, alinhada ao perfil do cliente;
  • Responsável pelo relacionamento com o cliente, visando assegurar a satisfação, atendimento, fidelização, rentabilização e a retenção dos clientes de todos os segmentos de negócios da Seguros Unimed;
  • Realizar negociações dentro dos padrões e normas definidas pela empresa, através da orientação, análise e validação dos contratos comerciais, acompanhamento e monitoramento dos processos de negociações;
  • Realizar vendasde produtos e soluções, de contas de médio porte e impacto financeiro, buscando o atingimento das metas de vendas, através do acompanhamento dos resultados, elaboração de planos de ações para expansão do mercado e desenvolvimento de novos mercados;
  • Manter cadastrode clientes atualizado, bem como manter-se informado do potencial e situação financeira dos mesmos;
  • Identificar novas demandas externas, quais as necessidades e o potencial do mercado, desenvolvendo novos clientes e buscando continuamente novas oportunidades de negócios para a empresa;
  • Promover e fortalecer a imagem da empresa no mercado, cumprindo a estratégia e plano de ações de marketing, identificando necessidades e oportunidades de divulgação e disseminação dos produtos, soluções e marca, monitorando efetividade das ações mercadológicas;
  • Organizar toda a demanda ou processos advindos do escritório regional, corretoras ou a pessoa jurídica, sendo resolutivo, revendo prazos, rotinas e assegurando treinamentos quando identificada a necessidade de melhorias, alinhada ao perfil do cliente;
  • Acompanhar o desempenho do mercado e da concorrência, procurando conhecer os produtos e a similaridade dos mesmos com os produtos da empresa.;
  • Participar ativamente de programas de melhoria da qualidade dos produtos, serviços e meio ambiente, cumprir as normas internas e de segurança do trabalho;
  • Prestar suporteaos clientes e parceiros, no que se refere às peculiaridades da empresa, contribuindo com a melhoria dos serviços a serem prestados;
  • Buscar a geração de novas oportunidades, mediante identificação dos pontos que podem ser trabalhados no cliente, imaginando e propondo soluções;
  • Contribuir parasoluções técnicas e aperfeiçoamento técnico dos produtos através de informações de mercado;
  • Controlar reclamações de clientes, fazendo follow-up na área competente para retorno e devolução rápida, bem como acompanhar a resolução de problemas internos do pós venda;
  • Elaborar relatórios de vendas, especificando os resultados obtidos e mantendo o superior hierárquico informado sobre o andamento das vendas, volume de vendas e tendências futuras do mercado;
  • Cumprir o regulamento interno, normas e procedimentos de saúde, higiene e segurança do trabalho inerentes ao setor, bem como as observações dos requisitos de compliance, observação e o cumprimento das regulamentações atinentes à empresa;
  • Desenvolver outras atividades inerentes ao cargo ou a critério de seu superior imediato, desde que habilitado e estejam de acordo com o seu conhecimento e experiência;




Esperamos de você:

  • Informática – Pacote Office;
  • Foco em Resultados e Execução;

Informações adicionais

  • Tipo de contrato: CLT
  • Horário de trabalho: de segunda a sexta-feira, comercial flexível;
  • Local de trabalho: Fortaleza - CE
  • Todos os nossos processos seletivos são totalmente online nas etapas iniciais.


A Seguros Unimed respeita a pluralidade de identidades e trabalha para promover uma cultura inclusiva. Não fazemos distinção de raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade em nenhuma etapa do processo seletivo, reforçando nosso compromisso de uma empresa focada em cooperar e no seu cliente interno e externo.

title: Líder Técnico
description:
Quem Somos

A DEXIAN é uma consultoria global de origem Americana focada em talentos para complementar a equipe de tecnologia da informação de nossos clientes. Estamos presente em 10 países, com 45 escritórios ao redor do mundo. Por mais de 25 anos, a DEXIAN® atende indústrias e clientes globais, em diversas áreas, com a missão de atrair e reter os maiores talentos do mundo.

Hoje somos orgulhosamente reconhecidos como uma das maiores empresas de “staffing augmentation” dos Estados Unidos pela Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA). Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

No Brasil, chegamos em 2007 e de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia.


O que esperar de nós

É importante que você saiba que por trás de cada movimento DEXIAN existem cinco valores fundamentais: colaboração, respeito, justiça, comprometimento e engenhosidade. Colaboração, justiça e respeito não são apenas palavras;
comprometimento não é só um pensamento;
e engenhosidade vai além de aspiração. Essas qualidades nos definem em todos os níveis, todas as parcerias e na forma como trabalhamos todos os dias. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

A DEXIAN do Brasil incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.


Nosso Cliente

Esta posição atuará em apoio ao nosso cliente, uma multinacional líder no segmento de cruzeiros marítimos.


Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Tech Lead to drive the technical direction of our mobile application development effort. You will serve as the technical anchor for a cross-functional team, ensuring architectural integrity, mentoring developers, and bridging the gap between business requirements and technical execution. You will work closely with product owners, QA, and stakeholders to deliver a high-quality, scalable mobile product.


Key Responsibilities

  • Architect and own the end-to-end technical design for Android and iOS mobile applications
  • Define and enforce development standards, coding guidelines, and best practices across the team
  • Lead sprint planning, technical grooming, and estimation sessions in JIRA
  • Create, manage, and prioritize JIRA epics, user stories, and technical tasks
  • Collaborate with Backend Developer to design RESTful/GraphQL APIs and data contracts
  • Drive CI/CD pipeline strategy and release management processes
  • Conduct code reviews and provide mentorship to senior and mid-level developers
  • Partner with Sr. SDET to define test automation strategies using Selenium and Playwright
  • Identify and remediate technical debt proactively
  • Communicate technical risks and trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders
  • Ensure cross-platform consistency in UX/UI behavior and performance benchmarks
  • Participate in hiring, onboarding, and performance evaluations for engineering staff


Required Qualifications

  • Advenced english is primordial, you'll work with an international team.
  • 10+ years of software engineering experience with at least 4 years in a technical lead role
  • Deep expertise in mobile application development (Android and/or iOS)
  • Proven experience designing scalable microservices and RESTful API architectures
  • Strong proficiency with JIRA including epics, sprints, backlogs, and reporting
  • Experience integrating Selenium and/or Playwright in mobile/web test automation pipelines
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Bitrise
  • Demonstrated practice and advocacy of Test Driven Development (TDD) across engineering teams
  • Solid understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
  • Excellent communication and technical leadership skills
  • Experience leading both Android and iOS native development teams simultaneously
  • Familiarity with Kotlin Multiplatform or React Native cross-platform frameworks
  • Background in mobile security practices and OWASP Mobile Top 10
  • Experience with mobile observability tools such as Firebase Crashlytics or Datadog


Onde você vai trabalhar?

Regime 100% Home Office.


Tempo de Projeto:

Tempo indeterminado.
